# P12 — Ruth 4:9-12

## 1. Metadata
- **Pericope title:** You are witnesses this day: the names spoken and the gate's blessing
- **BCV:** Ruth 4:9-12
- **Genre Group:** NARRATIVE
- **Genre:** HISTORICAL_NARRATIVE
- **Register:** INFORMAL_CASUAL

*(Versification note: Ruth's chapter and verse numbers are the same in English and Hebrew — no divergence in this pericope.)*

**Multi-level register tagging:**
The whole passage sits in INFORMAL_CASUAL — the narrator's framing of the two speeches ("and Boaz said," "and all the people said"). Scene 1, Boaz's declaration (4:9–10), is FORMAL_OFFICIAL at scene level: a legal declaration before witnesses, spoken to the elders and all the people and opened and closed by "you are witnesses today." Scene 2, the people's and elders' answer and blessing (4:11–12), is CEREMONIAL at scene level: a communal blessing in set, weighty form, naming YHWH, Rachel and Leah, and the house of Perez whom Tamar bore to Judah.

## 2. Level 1 — Whole-Passage Movement

### 2.1 Prose Arc / Shape / Argument / Burden / Concern
The passage is the purchase made public. Boaz says to the elders and all the people what he has done: you are witnesses today that I have bought all that was Elimelech's, and all that was Chilion's and Mahlon's, from Naomi's hand — and also Ruth the Moabite, the wife of Mahlon, I have bought to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance, so that the name of the dead is not cut off from his kindred and from the gate of his place; you are witnesses today. Here, for the first time, the story says whose wife Ruth was: she is the wife of Mahlon. All the people at the gate and the elders answer: we are witnesses. Then they bless: may YHWH make the woman coming into your house like Rachel and Leah, who together built the house of Israel; do worthily in Ephrathah and call out a name in Bethlehem; and may your house be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, from the seed that YHWH will give you from this young woman. What weighs on the passage is the names and the blessing: the dead are named before witnesses, and Ruth as the wife of Mahlon; and the name of God, which no one said in the proceeding, is spoken by the people in the blessing.

### 2.2 Context
After the sandal is drawn off (4:8), Boaz speaks to the elders and all the people. His declaration says the whole matter in one public speech: all that was Elimelech's, Chilion's and Mahlon's, bought from Naomi's hand, and Ruth the Moabite, the wife of Mahlon, bought to be his wife, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance — the words he spoke at 4:5. At 4:5 Ruth was "the wife of the dead"; here she is "the wife of Mahlon". The blessing names Rachel and Leah, the two who built the house of Israel, and the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah; it tells no more of them than that. No one said the name of God in the whole proceeding (4:1–10); here, in the blessing, the people say it. Neither Ruth nor Naomi speaks.

### 2.3 Emotion / Tone / Pace
Formal, full, and rising. The declaration is dense and exact — every party named, every clause of the purchase laid out, "you are witnesses" opening and closing it. The assembly's answer is a single word, choral and quick. Then the blessing opens the passage outward and lifts it: three wishes — the woman like Rachel and Leah; worth in Ephrathah and a name in Bethlehem; a house like the house of Perez — ending on "the seed that YHWH will give you from this young woman". The pace moves from the tight legal recital to the broad, generous swing of the blessing.

### 2.4 Communicative Function
This passage makes the purchase public before witnesses. Boaz names all that he has bought from Naomi's hand — all that was Elimelech's, Chilion's and Mahlon's — and Ruth the Moabite, the wife of Mahlon, bought to be his wife; for the first time the story says whose wife Ruth was. He says again the words of 4:5 — to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance — and adds: so that the name of the dead is not cut off from his kindred and from the gate of his place. All the people at the gate and the elders answer: witnesses; and they bless, and in the blessing the name of God is spoken, which no one said in the proceeding. The blessing likens the woman coming into Boaz's house to Rachel and Leah, and his house to the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah. To speak this passage is to keep the legal exactness of the declaration, the choral assent, the rising blessing, and the names — all the names — spoken aloud.

## 3. Level 2 — Scenes / Episodes

### Scene 1 — Boaz's declaration: the purchase, the names, the witnesses (4:9–10)

**3A — Beings**

[[B13-Boaz]] — בֹּעַז / Boaz
- Role: the buyer who declares the whole transaction before the assembly and calls them to witness
- Relationship: the one who now holds the right of redemption (4:6–8)
- Presence: PRESENT

[[B20-Elders]] — הַזְּקֵנִים / "the elders"
- Role: the seated court, named first among those called to witness
- Relationship: the town's elders convened at the gate
- Presence: PRESENT

[[B21-All-the-People-at-the-Gate]] — כָּל־הָעָם / "all the people"
- Role: the wider assembly called to witness alongside the elders
- Relationship: the townspeople gathered at the gate
- Presence: PRESENT

[[B2-Elimelech]] — אֱלִימֶלֶךְ / Elimelech
- Role: the dead head of the line whose holdings Boaz has bought
- Relationship: the dead husband of Naomi
- Presence: REFERENCED

[[B5-Chilion]] — כִּלְיוֹן / Chilion
- Role: one of the dead sons whose portion is included
- Relationship: dead son of Elimelech and Naomi
- Presence: REFERENCED

[[B4-Mahlon]] — מַחְלוֹן / Mahlon
- Role: the dead son; here, for the first time, the story says he was Ruth's husband
- Relationship: dead son of Elimelech and Naomi; the husband of Ruth
- Referential form: named by Boaz; Ruth is "the wife of Mahlon"
- Presence: REFERENCED

[[B3-Naomi]] — נָעֳמִי / Naomi
- Role: the hand the holdings are bought from
- Relationship: widow of Elimelech; mother-in-law of Ruth
- Presence: REFERENCED

[[B9-Ruth]] — רוּת הַמּוֹאֲבִיָּה אֵשֶׁת מַחְלוֹן / "Ruth the Moabite, the wife of Mahlon"
- Role: the widow Boaz declares he has bought to be his wife, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance
- Relationship: the Moabite daughter-in-law of Naomi; widow of Mahlon
- Referential form: "Ruth the Moabite, the wife of Mahlon" — the foreigner-marker, and her husband named
- Presence: REFERENCED

The dead — הַמֵּת / "the dead"
- Role: the one whose name Boaz says the purchase is to raise up upon his inheritance and keep from being cut off
- Relationship: Ruth's late husband; in this declaration he is named: Mahlon
- Presence: REFERENCED

**3B — Places**

[[PL7-Gate]] — שַׁעַר מְקוֹמוֹ / "the gate of his place"
- Role: the venue of the witnessing, and the place from which the dead man's name is not to be cut off
- Type: the town gate, the public meeting-and-law place
- Effect on scene: the gate is where the matter is done before everyone; and "the gate of his place" is what the name of the dead is not to be cut off from

**3C — Objects and Concepts**

[[CB_0001-Kinsman-Redeemer]] — קָנִיתִי / "I have bought"
- What it is: the buying Boaz declares — the right of redemption, now his, carried out
- Function in scene: "I have bought", said twice in the declaration (4:9, 4:10), before witnesses

[[CB_0005-Name-Preservation]] — לְהָקִים שֵׁם־הַמֵּת / "to raise up the name of the dead"
- What it is: raising up the name of the dead upon his inheritance
- Function in scene: the stated purpose of acquiring Ruth — the buying is for the name

[[CB_0002-Widow-Acquired-to-Raise-Up-the-Name-of-the-Dead]] — אֵשֶׁת מַחְלוֹן … לְאִשָּׁה / "the wife of Mahlon … as wife"
- What it is: the widow bought, so that the name of the dead is raised up upon his inheritance
- Function in scene: what Boaz says buying Ruth is for

[[CB_0039-Living-and-Dead-Formula]] — שֵׁם־הַמֵּת … לֹא־יִכָּרֵת / "the name of the dead … not cut off"
- What it is: the dead man kept in the family's reckoning: "the dead"
- Function in scene: Boaz's words "so that the name of the dead is not cut off from his kindred and from the gate of his place"; only "the dead" is said here

[[CB_0003-Inheritance]] — עַל־נַחֲלָתוֹ / "upon his inheritance"
- What it is: the dead man's inheritance
- Function in scene: "upon his inheritance" — where the name of the dead is to be raised up

[[CB_0004-Moabite-Outsider]] — הַמּוֹאֲבִיָּה / "the Moabite"
- What it is: the foreigner-marker
- Function in scene: the foreigner-marker, spoken by Boaz in his declaration

[[CB_0006-Gate-Legal-Venue]] — מִשַּׁעַר מְקוֹמוֹ / "from the gate of his place"
- What it is: the gate as the town's legal venue — where what is done is done before everyone
- Function in scene: "from the gate of his place" — the name of the dead is not to be cut off from it

**3D — Times**

[[TM_TODAY-Today]] — הַיּוֹם / "today"
- What it is: the day of the witnessing — twice named, opening and closing the declaration
- Function: "you are witnesses today", said at the opening and at the close of the declaration

**3E — What Happens**
[[B13-Boaz]] Boaz says to [[B20-Elders]] the elders and to [[B21-All-the-People-at-the-Gate]] all the people: you are witnesses today that I have bought all that was [[B2-Elimelech]] Elimelech's, and all that was [[B5-Chilion]] Chilion's and [[B4-Mahlon]] Mahlon's, from the hand of [[B3-Naomi]] Naomi; and also [[B9-Ruth]] Ruth the Moabite, the wife of Mahlon, I have bought to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance, so that the name of the dead is not cut off from his kindred and from the gate of his place — you are witnesses today.

**3F — Communicative Purpose**
Makes the purchase public before witnesses: all that was Elimelech's, Chilion's and Mahlon's, from Naomi's hand, and Ruth the Moabite, the wife of Mahlon, to be Boaz's wife — to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance. Here, for the first time, the story says whose wife Ruth was.

**Significant Absence**
Neither Ruth nor Naomi speaks. At the gate no one speaks of the night at the threshing floor. No one says the name of God in Boaz's declaration.

### Scene 2 — The assembly's witness and blessing (4:11–12)

**3A — Beings**

[[B21-All-the-People-at-the-Gate]] — כָּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־בַּשַּׁעַר / "all the people who were at the gate"
- Role: the assembly that answers "we are witnesses" and speaks the blessing
- Relationship: the townspeople at the gate
- Presence: PRESENT

[[B20-Elders]] — הַזְּקֵנִים / "the elders"
- Role: the elders joined in the witness and the blessing
- Relationship: the seated court
- Presence: PRESENT

[[B10-YHWH]] — יְהוָה / YHWH
- Role: the one the blessing asks to make the woman coming into Boaz's house like Rachel and Leah, and to give the seed
- Relationship: the God of Israel, named here for the first time since the proceeding began
- Presence: REFERENCED

[[B13-Boaz]] — בֵּיתֶךָ / "your house"
- Role: the one the blessing is spoken to — his house, and "the seed that YHWH will give you"
- Relationship: the one who has just declared he has bought Ruth to be his wife
- Presence: PRESENT

[[B9-Ruth]] — הָאִשָּׁה הַבָּאָה אֶל־בֵּיתֶךָ … הַנַּעֲרָה הַזֹּאת / "the woman coming into your house … this young woman"
- Role: the woman the blessing likens to Rachel and Leah; the young woman the blessing asks seed from
- Relationship: Ruth, not named here — "the woman coming into your house", "this young woman"
- Presence: REFERENCED

[[B22-Rachel-and-Leah]] — רָחֵל וְלֵאָה / Rachel and Leah
- Role: the two the woman coming into Boaz's house is likened to — who together built the house of Israel
- Relationship: named in the blessing as the two who built the house of Israel
- Presence: REFERENCED

[[B27-Perez-and-His-Descendants]] — פֶּרֶץ / Perez
- Role: the one whose house Boaz's house is likened to
- Relationship: the son Tamar bore to Judah
- Presence: REFERENCED

[[B23-Tamar]] — תָּמָר / Tamar
- Role: the one who bore Perez to Judah
- Relationship: named in the blessing as the mother of Perez
- Presence: REFERENCED

[[B30-Judah]] — יְהוּדָה / Judah
- Role: the one to whom Tamar bore Perez
- Relationship: named in the blessing as the father of Perez
- Presence: REFERENCED

**3B — Places**

[[PL7-Gate]] — בַּשַּׁעַר / "at the gate"
- Role: where the people witness and bless
- Type: the town gate, the assembly's place
- Effect on scene: the blessing is spoken at the gate, before everyone

[[PL_ISRAEL-Israel]] — יִשְׂרָאֵל / Israel
- Role: "the house of Israel" — what Rachel and Leah built
- Type: the people of Israel
- Effect on scene: names the house the blessing speaks of

[[PL8-Ephrathah]] — אֶפְרָתָה / Ephrathah
- Role: the place the blessing names for Boaz to do worthily in
- Type: a place name joined to Bethlehem; the book has called Elimelech's family "Ephrathites from Bethlehem in Judah" (1:2)
- Effect on scene: named side by side with Bethlehem

[[PL1-Bethlehem-of-Judah]] — בֵּית לֶחֶם / Bethlehem
- Role: the town the blessing names for Boaz to call out a name in
- Type: the town Naomi and Ruth came to (1:19)
- Effect on scene: where the blessing tells Boaz to call out a name

**3C — Objects and Concepts**

[[CB_0008-Blessing]] — the people's blessing
- What it is: a communal blessing in set, weighty form
- Function in scene: the assembly's blessing on Boaz — the woman like Rachel and Leah; do worthily and call out a name; the house like the house of Perez

[[CB_0010-House-of-Israel]] — בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל / "the house of [[PL_ISRAEL-Israel]] Israel"
- What it is: "the house of Israel" — the house Rachel and Leah built
- Function in scene: what Rachel and Leah built, in the blessing's words

[[CB_0049-Perez-as-Lineage-Founder]] — בֵּית פֶּרֶץ / "the house of Perez"
- What it is: "the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah"
- Function in scene: the house the blessing likens Boaz's house to

**3D — Times**
- None: no distinct temporal frame; the blessing follows the witness directly, within the same assembly.

**3E — What Happens**
[[B21-All-the-People-at-the-Gate]] All the people at the gate and [[B20-Elders]] the elders say: we are witnesses. May [[B10-YHWH]] YHWH make [[B9-Ruth]] the woman coming into your house like [[B22-Rachel-and-Leah]] Rachel and Leah, who together built the house of Israel. Do worthily in [[PL8-Ephrathah]] Ephrathah and call out a name in [[PL1-Bethlehem-of-Judah]] Bethlehem. And may your house be like the house of [[B27-Perez-and-His-Descendants]] Perez, whom [[B23-Tamar]] Tamar bore to [[B30-Judah]] Judah, from the seed that YHWH will give you from this young woman.

**3F — Communicative Purpose**
All the people at the gate and the elders answer: we are witnesses. Then they bless: may YHWH make the woman coming into Boaz's house like Rachel and Leah; may Boaz do worthily in Ephrathah and call out a name in Bethlehem; may his house be like the house of Perez, from the seed YHWH will give him from this young woman. In the blessing the name of God is said, which no one said in the proceeding.

**Significant Absence**
Neither Ruth nor Naomi speaks. The seed is asked for, not told as given. The blessing tells no more of Rachel and Leah, of Tamar, Judah and Perez, than it says here.

## 4. Level 3 — Proposition Inventory

### Proposition 1 — Ruth 4:9a [Scene 1]
- **Q:** What happened? **A:** declaring
- **Q:** Who spoke? **A:** [[B13-Boaz]] Boaz
- **Q:** To whom? **A:** [[B20-Elders]] the elders
- **Q:** And to whom else? **A:** [[B21-All-the-People-at-the-Gate]] all the people
- **Q:** What did he call them? **A:** witnesses today

### Proposition 2 — Ruth 4:9b [Scene 1]
- **Q:** What did he declare? **A:** he has bought all that was Elimelech's
- **Q:** Whose else? **A:** all that was Chilion's and Mahlon's
- **Q:** From whom? **A:** from the hand of [[B3-Naomi]] Naomi

### Proposition 3 — Ruth 4:10a [Scene 1]
- **Q:** What else did he declare? **A:** he has bought Ruth the Moabite
- **Q:** Whose wife was she? **A:** the wife of [[B4-Mahlon]] Mahlon
- **Q:** To be what? **A:** his wife

### Proposition 4 — Ruth 4:10b [Scene 1]
- **Q:** Toward what end? **A:** to raise up the name of the dead
- **Q:** Upon what? **A:** upon his inheritance

### Proposition 5 — Ruth 4:10c [Scene 1]
- **Q:** So that what would not happen? **A:** the name of the dead would not be cut off
- **Q:** Cut off from where? **A:** from his kindred
- **Q:** And from where else? **A:** from the gate of his place

### Proposition 6 — Ruth 4:10d [Scene 1]
- **Q:** What did he repeat? **A:** you are witnesses
- **Q:** When? **A:** today

### Proposition 7 — Ruth 4:11a [Scene 2]
- **Q:** What happened? **A:** answering
- **Q:** Who spoke? **A:** [[B21-All-the-People-at-the-Gate]] all the people at the gate
- **Q:** And who else? **A:** [[B20-Elders]] the elders
- **Q:** What did they say? **A:** we are witnesses

### Proposition 8 — Ruth 4:11b [Scene 2]
- **Q:** What happened? **A:** blessing
- **Q:** Whom did they invoke? **A:** [[B10-YHWH]] YHWH
- **Q:** What did they ask? **A:** make the woman coming into your house like [[B22-Rachel-and-Leah]] Rachel and Leah
- **Q:** Who were they? **A:** the two who built the house of [[PL_ISRAEL-Israel]] Israel

### Proposition 9 — Ruth 4:11c [Scene 2]
- **Q:** What did they bless further? **A:** do worthily in [[PL8-Ephrathah]] Ephrathah
- **Q:** And? **A:** call out a name in [[PL1-Bethlehem-of-Judah]] Bethlehem

### Proposition 10 — Ruth 4:12a [Scene 2]
- **Q:** What did they bless further? **A:** may your house be like the house of [[B27-Perez-and-His-Descendants]] Perez
- **Q:** Who was Perez? **A:** the one whom [[B23-Tamar]] Tamar bore to [[B30-Judah]] Judah

### Proposition 11 — Ruth 4:12b [Scene 2]
- **Q:** From what would the house come? **A:** from the seed YHWH will give him
- **Q:** From whom? **A:** from this young woman
